notes: Trail regions for the planned trail-region map, and the parks and cities in each.
To move a park or city to another region, change its "region" (one line). Then run python tools/build_boundaries.py to rebuild data/parks.geojson and data/cities.geojson (see README, Boundary data).
region must be one of the ids under "regions".
Parks: "match" lists OpenStreetMap names (case-insensitive) to try in turn; the first that finds anything is used. "osm" pins the exact OpenStreetMap object instead.
"also" adds more OpenStreetMap pieces to a park, by exact name or as "relation/123" or "way/123": OpenStreetMap maps Midpen preserves as an open part plus separately named closed areas.
Cities: "east_of" is the road the city is cut along (only the bay side is kept, minus parks): "I-280" or "Foothill Boulevard" (the lines are defined in tools/build_boundaries.py, CUT_LINES).
Cities: "census_geoid" is the city's 7-digit id in the US Census places file (names alone are ambiguous: there is also a Mountain View in Contra Costa County).
